question: Can a bounded supervised fit improve atlas propagation agreement while preserving RMD rhythms and changed-weight numerical consistency?
fixed: All passive/kinetic/reversal/release/calcium/indicator constants, anatomy, channel templates, initial-state rules and fixed bias; LEAK reference and every RMD channel scale fixed. No added edges or peptide term.
trainable: Unknown positive non-RMD/non-LEAK channel log scales, anatomical chemical raw strengths, one shared offset per undirected anatomical gap pair. All302 cells remain simulated. Bound each coordinate within0.1 of audited selected parent; gap offsets applied symmetrically, retaining original asymmetry of raw representation.
optimizer: One trajectory, antithetic SPSA with Adam (lr0.002, perturbation0.005, beta0.9/0.999), seed1130. Two persistent A100 evaluation workers. Paired training-target minibatches of2; every fifth iteration includes an eligible fine-group training target when available. Only train labels enter updates. Save every proposed model, batch, direction, optimizer/RNG and decision; no exact live-worker resume claim.
objective: Existing clipped-z pooled/per-target Pearson correlation loss (clip5), plus0.001 mean squared normalized parameter offsets. Scale-invariant propagation statistic, not absolute calcium-amplitude calibration. Common source full-state anchors are explicit fixed conditioning states during optimization, not claimed to be each candidate's own attractor.
screen: Evaluate every trial at middle and finest E112 target-group steps, same four phases/pulse clocks, duplicate/padded shams. Require finite values, controls, existing per-pair mixed numerical resolution, absolute train/validation loss-grid disagreement<=0.02 and RMD persistence/period-amplitude preservation relative to parent at same step/phase. Screens are provisional; final full three-level vector/mixed checks unchanged. Accept proposed updates only when same-minibatch training loss improves. Provisional best checkpoint chosen by full validation loss, never test scores.
budget: 480minutes TOTAL under nohup private-group watchdog. Optimization stops by330minutes from initial start. At least150minutes reserved for source/candidate fresh neural states, long RMD checks, full135-target/6462-pair three-level response validation and automatic audit. Do not start optimization batches that cannot fit the remaining optimization budget. Timeout/incomplete never qualifies.
final: Choose provisional best validation checkpoint before final/test evaluation, retaining final optimizer state separately. Fresh unforced60s settling/40s recording of parent and candidate at0.03125/0.015625ms, with own full-state phase anchors; require RMD persistence and candidate period/mean-amplitude within10%/25% of parent on both grids. Report strict cycle comparisons separately. Recompute all three E112 step levels on candidate's fresh anchors, all targets/phases/observed pairs; require unchanged numerical/controls/rhythm gates. No assumption original target-dependent assignment remains valid after fitting. Test scores reported only after selection; repeated historical test inspection acknowledged.
acceptance: Fitting success requires actual parameter changes, improved validation loss versus parent conditioning baseline AND fresh-state final validation improvement, frozen fields/bounds intact, full final numerical checks, own-state RMD gates and complete execution/audit. Failure retains candidate and original parent; no automatic behavior/biological promotion or fallback relabeled as trained success.
recordkeeping: External compact means/sham-RMD/control summaries, immutable model/checkpoint/anchor snapshots, all optimizer/RNG/direction records, exact source/environment/argv, selection ledger and full input/output hashes. No per-proposal full-brain long trajectory archives or raw data in Git. Automatic audit after success/failure/timeout covers execution, selection, parameter masks/bounds/frozen fields, signals, controls, numerical/rhythm gates and missing evidence.
